expected_issues.title: Permanent subscript wrapper disables the error entrance animation
expected_issues.description:
Errors and hints now share one permanent wrapper whose classes are toggled, so the error wrapper element is no longer created when an error appears and the error entrance animation (keyed on the element being inserted) never plays.

The subscript animation relies on `.mat-mdc-form-field-error-wrapper` being a newly inserted element when the control becomes invalid. Toggling classes on an always-present div removes that insertion, a visible UX regression on every form field. The live region can stay on the permanent parent while keeping distinct error/hint child wrappers.
